audit_metadata.title: Aspect Category Sentiment Analysis (ACSA) vs. Span-Level Aspect Term Extraction (ATE) Audit
framework_citations: Pontiki et al. (2014) SemEval-2014 Task 4: Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis
Pontiki et al. (2016) SemEval-2016 Task 5: Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis
Sun, Huang, & Qiu (2019) Utilizing BERT for ABSA via Constructing Auxiliary Sentence (NAACL)
Liu, B. (2020) Sentiment Analysis: Mining Opinions, Sentiments, and Emotions (Cambridge UP)
Schouten & Frasincar (2016) Survey on Aspect-Level Sentiment Analysis (IEEE TKDE)
Zhang et al. (2022) A Survey on Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (IEEE TKDE)

granularity_and_span_metrics.implication_for_ate: Pure span-level extraction drops 42.59% of citizen grievances due to zero-span implicit expressions (e.g., sarcastic portion shrinkage).

methodology_comparison.eval_verdict: ACSA aligns with communicative holism in public policy evaluation.

methodology_comparison.acsa_formulation: Predefined Macro Policy Category C in {A1, A2, A3}
methodology_comparison.span_level_ate: Surface Syntactic Noun Phrase / Head Token
methodology_comparison.eval_verdict: ACSA models institutional governance pillars rather than disjointed product features.

methodology_comparison.span_level_ate: High False-Negative Loss (Zero-span omission for 42.6% of implicit expressions)
methodology_comparison.eval_verdict: ACSA avoids catastrophic truncation of sarcastic citizen dissent.

methodology_comparison.acsa_formulation: Captures cross-sequence emoji-text incongruence (e.g. 🤡🤮 at end)
methodology_comparison.span_level_ate: Localized token context window fails on distant emoji pretense
methodology_comparison.eval_verdict: ACSA eliminates false-positive praise from policy sentiment audits.

methodology_comparison.acsa_formulation: Canonical Standard in Computational Communication (Sun et al., 2019)
methodology_comparison.span_level_ate: Consumer E-Commerce Paradigm (SemEval Pontiki et al., 2014)
methodology_comparison.eval_verdict: ACSA is theoretically justified for macro-institutional public administration.
